title: sla
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): businesshoursid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, transactioncurrencyid, workflowid.

allowpauseresume.description: Select whether this SLA will allow pausing and resuming during the time calculation.

applicablefrom.description: Select the field that specifies the date and time from which the SLA items will be calculated for the case record.

applicablefrompicklist.description: Select the field that specifies the date and time from which the SLA items will be calculated.

changedattributelist.description: Type additional information to describe the SLA

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the SLA

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate between the currency associated with the SLA record and the base currency.

isdefault.description: Tells whether this SLA is the default one.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name of the service level agreement (SLA).

objecttypecode.description: Choose the entity type that the SLA is defined.

primaryentityotc.description: Shows the primary entity that the SLA has been created for.

slatype.description: Select the type of service level agreement (SLA).

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statecode.description: Shows whether the Service Level Agreement (SLA) is active or inactive.

statuscode.description: Select the status of the service level agreement (SLA).

_businesshoursid_value.description: Choose the business hours for calculating SLA item timelines.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who owns the SLA.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the currency associated with the SLA record.
